title: 第479章 双重威压
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

月华之下，

一个人类手持比他还高的长剑，正和一个大蜥蜴缠斗不休。

更诡异的是，

在不远处的山头，一只猫咪和骷髅正坐在那里当观众。

月华灵猫趴在骸骨之王的头顶，软糯的叫着。

“喵～”（你怎么不上去打两下？”)

骸骨之王眼中魂火跳动，“吼。”（我的剑在战斗）

月华灵猫舔了舔爪子，“喵喵～”（好剑）

“……”(°ー°〃)

骸骨之王魂火一顿，僵在原地。

远处的密林中，

此时已经不见一棵完整的树木，

大地纵横交错着恐怖的剑痕，遍地都是坑洞和裂缝，整片林地被打得面目全非。

林奇扛着终末大剑，胸膛剧烈起伏，额角的汗水顺着下颌不断滑落。

打了这么久，他虽然没有受伤，可体力却消耗巨大。

反观对面的青纹岩蜥，身上虽然遍布剑痕和黑焰灼烧的痕迹。

可蜕层皮人家就恢复如初了。

凶性丝毫未减，依旧蛰伏在地，死死锁定林奇。

“真不愧是卡兽排行榜中，最难缠的那几种，这生命力比熔岩龙蜥还要难杀。”

这青纹岩蜥虽然战力比不上熔岩龙蜥，可它的生命力绝对比熔岩龙蜥还要变态。

皮厚、耐打、还有再生，蜕皮自愈的能力，简直是御卡师的噩梦。

“不能再这样打下去了。”

林奇知道，再这么下去，就算自己最后搞定了这家伙，也没有力气去攻打山寨了。

“骸骨之王，交给你了。”

林奇甩出张卡牌，拖着终末大剑就往月华灵猫的方向走。

“嘶嘶！”

青纹岩蜥瞳孔一亮，猛的弹射起步。

转瞬间来到林奇上空10米，长舌一卷，冲着他后背直射而来。

“刷刷！”

就在这千钧一发之际，

一张猩红大网猛的从地面射出，直接断绝青纹岩蜥笼所有退路。

“嘶嘶！！”

青纹岩蜥跌落在地，四只利爪拼命地挣扎着，想撕破这大网。

可任凭它怎么撕扯、疯狂冲撞，这毒网依旧纹丝不动，牢牢禁锢住它的身躯。

“呵呵，上当了吧？”

林奇转过身来，一脸戏谑。

“猩红妖藤进阶领主之后，这毒网也是跟着提升了。

你生命力顽强不惧怕物理打击，但我不信，你能抵挡诅咒和毒素。”

“嘶~”

青纹岩蜥露出獠牙，朝着林奇愤怒地嘶吼着。

猩红妖藤再次喷出一道毒网，

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Under the moonlight,

A human was holding a sword that was taller than him and was fighting with a large lizard.

What’s even weirder is,

On the hilltop not far away, a cat and skeleton were sitting there as spectators.

The Moonlight Civet lay on top of the King of Skeletons, meowing softly.

"Meow~" (Why don't you go up and hit me twice?")

Soul fire danced in the King of Skeleton's eyes, "Roar."(My sword is fighting)

The Moonlight Civet licked its paws and said, "Meow meow~" (Good sword)

"..."(°ー°〃)

The King of Skeletons was stunned and froze in place.

In the distant dense forest,

At this time, there was no complete tree left.

The ground was crisscrossed with horrific sword marks, filled with holes and cracks, and the entire forest was beaten beyond recognition.

Lin Qi carried the final sword, his chest heaved violently, and the sweat on his forehead kept sliding down his chin.

After fighting for so long, although he was not injured, his physical strength was greatly consumed.

On the other hand, the blue-patterned rock lizard opposite had sword marks and black flame burn marks all over its body.

But people with shed skin have returned to their original state.

The ferocity has not diminished at all, and he is still dormant on the ground, locked on Lin Qi.

"It is indeed one of the most difficult beasts to deal with in the ranking of monsters. Its vitality is even more difficult to kill than the Lava Dragon Lizard."

Although this blue-striped rock lizard is not as powerful as the lava dragon lizard, its vitality is definitely more perverted than the lava dragon lizard.

The skin is thick, durable, regenerates, and has the ability to shed and heal itself, which is simply a card master's nightmare.

“We can’t continue fighting like this."

Lin Qi knew that if he continued like this, even if he finally got rid of this guy, he wouldn't have the strength to attack the stronghold.

"King of Bones, I leave it to you."

Lin Qi threw out a card, dragged the final sword and walked in the direction of the Yuehua Civet.

"Hiss!"

The blue-striped rock lizard's pupils lit up and it started to launch fiercely.

In an instant, he was 10 meters above Lynch, and with a long tongue, he shot directly at his back.

“Shuush!"

At this critical moment,

A large scarlet net shot out from the ground, directly cutting off all escape routes for the Blue Patterned Rock Lizard Cage.

"Hiss!!"

The blue-striped rock lizard fell to the ground, its four sharp claws struggling desperately, trying to tear through the big net.

But no matter how much it tears and rushes wildly, the poisonous net remains motionless, tightly confining its body.

"Haha, have you been fooled?"

Lynch turned around with a joking look on his face.

“After Scarlet Demonic Vine advanced to Lord, this poisonous net also improved accordingly.

You have strong vitality and are not afraid of physical blows, but I don't believe that you can resist curses and poisons."

"Hiss~"

The blue-striped rock lizard bared its fangs and roared angrily at Lin Qi.

The scarlet demonic vine once again sprayed out a poisonous net,
